title: California DMV – Video Overlay + Endcard
summary: In-stream video with a clickable brand overlay and an interactive endcard linking to DMV online services.
description: Served from Collabo's ad server as a VAST 4 tag with a VPAID 2.0 JS creative. The video runs with a persistent "DMV online: Ready when you are" overlay and Learn More button, then hands off to an interactive endcard with four service shortcuts: vehicle registration, license renewal, change of address and paperless opt-in. The preview plays the real tag in a VAST/VPAID video player, the same way a publisher's player would. Press play to watch the full flow.
